title: Probe-bridge: gateway trace probe + SLO staging pipeline for noise-aware paging
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Current alerting floods oncall with redundant pages during short-lived microbursts and noisy downstream errors. We need a lightweight, low-cost trace probe running at the edge (ingress API/gateway) that attaches synthetic span fingerprints to requests, enriches metrics/logs with request-level fingerprints and SLO metadata, and feeds a SLO staging pipeline to evaluate burn-rate and anomaly signals before firing pages.

Goal: ship a Probe-Bridge service and a SLO Staging Pipeline that performs pre-alert enrichment and scoring so paging decisions are deduplicated and prioritized by blast-radius, customer-tier, and correlated trace signatures. This reduces noisy pagers while keeping high-fidelity alerting for real degradations.

Scope and deliverables:
- Edge probe shim in API gateway that emits a lightweight span fingerprint and request-class tag (product-route, customer-tier, sample-bucket). No full trace capture at edge.
- Metrics/log enrichment pipeline (Fluentd -> Kafka -> observability-ingest) that attaches the probe fingerprint to spans/metrics and persists fingerprint metadata for 72 hours.
- SLO Staging Pipeline: a separate evaluation layer that takes candidate alert signals, replays enriched telemetry, computes provisional burn-rate, cross-checks with recent probe-fingerprints, and assigns an urgency score.
- Smart pager router: rule engine that uses urgency score + customer impact map + historical dedupe to decide page vs. ticket, and selects oncall target; supports quiet-hours throttling and escalation windows.
- Dashboards: a latency/error dashboard showing provisional vs committed SLO burn, top fingerprint clusters, and paging efficiency metrics (pages avoided, pages escalated).

Trade-offs & constraints:
- Probe must be microsecond-scale and safe for 99th-percentile latency paths; will be written in native gateway language (Go) and feature-flagged per-route.
- Staging pipeline introduces ~30s evaluation window before some high-urgency pages emit; we will allow immediate escalation for critical customers via bypass tags.
- Retention costs for per-request fingerprint storage; limit to 72h and use compact fingerprint encoding.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Edge probe enabled on 3 high-traffic routes with negligible p99 latency regression (<2ms median impact).
2) Enriched telemetry is queryable in observability backend and correlates with at least 95% of sampled traces in test traffic.
3) SLO staging pipeline reduces duplicate pages by >=40% on the canary cohort during simulated microburst tests.
4) Smart pager rules support per-customer-tier bypass and quiet-hours throttling.

Rollout plan:
- Dev deploy: probe as feature-flag to internal staging for 2 weeks; pipeline runs in shadow mode (no pages) and logs decisions.
- Canary: enable on 5% of production traffic for two business-critical routes; monitor pages and latency for 72 hours.
- Gradual ramp: expand to more routes with weekly evaluation windows; defer critical-customer bypass until after SLOs validated.

Testing & validation:
- Synthetic microburst generator (k8s job) and injected downstream error scenarios.
- End-to-end tests: trace sampling compare, fingerprint collision rate tests, paging decision simulation.
- Dashboards: provisional-vs-committed SLO comparison, paging reduction KPIs, fingerprint cluster explorer.

Dependencies and links:
- API gateway PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/1328
- Ingest pipeline spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Probe-Bridge+Ingest+Spec
- Draft runbook for smart pager: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2bProbeBridgeRunbook
- SLO staging prototype: https://github.com/redwood-inference/obs-staging/tree/feature/probe-bridge

Open questions:
- What is the final compact fingerprint encoding format that balances collision risk vs storage? (proposal: 64-bit xxhash + 6-bit route bucketing)
- Should we persist full sampled traces for high-urgency incidents or rely on probe fingerprints to fetch traces lazily?

Acceptance tests and owner:
- Owner: Omar Patel (observability infra)
- QA: run synthetic workload harness and verify pages avoided; submit artifacts and dashboard screenshots to PR.
